research_notes: The final contract should specify whether elapsed time includes bootstrap; operationally it should, because invocation lifetime starts before substantive work.
Separate bootstrap timing can still be optimized later.
This prevents a worker from accidentally consuming the hard cap during a long bootstrap and then assuming a full work budget remains.
The current probe start timestamp was captured before substantive workload and scheduler pre-arm.
Thus its target semantics already follow the operational definition.
Final elapsed will use that start.
